Name: Cobblestone Path to Dark Grey Stone.
Author: GoddessOfThieves
Description:
A very very simple mod that darkens the default cobblestone path to an almost black grey. 

I'm using a mod of a friend's creation to turn the dirt to grass as seen in the screenshot, so that should be taken into account when you look at it.


Note: I forgot I  had another mod that changes the particular file as a different part. So that mod, the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51/?]Gravel  Path Fix  Mod[/url], by Yunix93 is currently included. When I  have some more time, I'll be making one that does not include her very nice mod, but until then, here is her credit. You  all should go support her awesome mod. 
Update: I  have now separated  her mod from mine, but ill leave the old file up there in case you want to use both at once, just make sure to endorse yunix if you like it. 

Second update: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70635993]MarigoldenSkies[/url] has made a cp version that is now uploaded here. 

To install: Back up the file in your Content folder (Content/TerrainFeatures/Flooring) if think you might want to revert later, then paste the file into your Content folder.
